'''August 2000 Glenside tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at RPG Outpost, Glenside, PA on 27 August 2000. [[Chris Praskac]] won it. It is known from Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1166">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-27-glenside-pa-8-27-00d1166/ glenside-pa-8-27-00], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 27 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-27-glenside-pa-8-27-00d1166/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 August 2000
* '''Site:''' RPG Outpost, Glenside, PA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 25
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Praskac]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Rich Baliban's own report gives his result as 3–3 with +3 differential (his game margins sum to +3) and says he came in '10th or something'; the director's standings list him 14th at 6 (0).<ref name="tr-d1166" />
* Baliban reports 3–3 with +3 differential and '10th or something'; the director's standings (Ted Panczyszyn) list him 14th at 6 (0).<ref name="tr-d1168">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-27-glenside-pa-8-27-00d1168/ glenside-pa-8-27-00], DeckTech (Rich "JekPorkins" Baliban, 27 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-27-glenside-pa-8-27-00d1168/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
